plan.title: design-critique walk rename and auto-stamp when agents agree

narratives.Description: walk iterates recorded parent-disagree headings. walk all is census. When the successor lean map is total over a non-empty classified-finding set and every heading is accept-into-contract, parent auto-posts the table and auto-stamps synthesis-accepted plus triage-ready.
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue #3640. Bind operator recut 5387144467. Supersedes 5387103656 and synthesis 5387111282. Pair exclusive chips #3642 and comment-lead role #3646.
narratives.Overview: Operator: if triage/parent and critic agree, do not bring the operator into the loop again. Blank/stub critic (zero classified headings) or dispatch-fail: stop and inform; do not stamp. Looks-good still does not bind. Non-empty disagree set prints walk / walk all / retry differences / accept. Walk does not auto-start. Takes: accept-into-contract / disagree / defer. Defer is not accepted. Keep one-release census alias for walk findings one at a time. Auto-stamp uses #3642 remaining-set replace and #3646 role: parent on auto-posted comments.
narratives.UserStory: As a parent after a critic, I want walk to mean only my disagreements, and when the map is all accept-into-contract I want table plus bind without another human verb.
narratives.When: When the contract uses walk and walk all, empty all-accept non-empty-finding map auto-posts table then synthesis-accepted and remaining-set-replaces to triage-ready, stub critics do not stamp, looks-good does not bind, tests pin those rules, and CHANGELOG has an Unreleased line.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Bind 5387144467, not 5386710951, 5386770411, 5387103656, or 5387111282. Out: table-auto/stamp-waits split; round-2 B1 table-offer on first-moment map; halt chip; auto-dispatch; third critic without cap raise. Sequence after #3642 and #3646. Dual-stop already spent on this issue's critique; do not dispatch another critic from this story.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: After 3642 and 3646 merge: recut contract operator verbs and empty-agreement auto-stamp; brief pointer; content-contract tests; thin skill; CHANGELOG. Closes #3640.
narratives.OriginDivergence: Issue body auto-bound even on immediate empty map including stubs. Critic B2 required non-empty classified set. Operator recut 5387144467 restored auto-stamp of table+bind when the two agents agree, after walk. Comments newer than body are SoT. 5388594631 (#3651 advisory, 2026-08-23T21:36:36Z) records a composed bind predicate with unresolved audit markers; it does not amend this brief or this issue's ceiling.
